placements.locator: Z. Phys. C 38 (1988) 117, Introduction; Greybook: beam H10
placements.note: Generic Prévessin North Area placement (NA = North Area); Greybook gives the beam line H10 but no fetched source names the hall.
placements.quote: NA38 is a dedicated experiment for the study of muon pairs produced in interactions of ultra-relativistic ions with dense matter.

summary.plain: A muon spectrometer with a ring-shaped magnet, plus a calorimeter and a multi-layer uranium target, that recorded pairs of muons from ion collisions at very high beam rates.
summary.technical: NA38: NA10 dimuon spectrometer (air-core hexagonal toroid, two sets of four multiwire proportional chambers, four scintillator hodoscopes, 4.8 m absorber), scintillating-fibre electromagnetic calorimeter (2 < eta < 4.2), ten-subtarget uranium active target and beam hodoscope/Cherenkov detectors.

technology.quote: The magnet is an air-core toroid with hexagonal symmetry
technology.value: Dimuon spectrometer (air-core toroidal magnet, multiwire proportional chambers, scintillator hodoscopes) with an electromagnetic calorimeter and a multiple active target
